note: Re-judged 2026-11-10 independently of the producer authors. RFC 5216 Section 5.3 requires support for retrieving intermediate certificates and then explicitly names pre-configuration or peer-provided intermediates as fallbacks for a server unable to retrieve them. clientChainVerifier.verify constructs Intermediates from configured and peer-sent certificates and calls x509.Certificate.Verify. newTLSMethod installs that verifier when configured intermediates exist, otherwise uses crypto/tls path validation; its remaining callbacks control revocation and TLS session tickets, not AIA retrieval. Neither boundary fetches caIssuers. The gap annotation accurately distinguishes the implemented fallback from absent retrieval; retain unimplemented, not enforced.
